description: In the late 1960s, an entrepreneur entered the funeral industry market and took on fierce competition, armed with a few revolutionary ideas.

Title: 791. Podne
description: The lives of many people in one Serbian town are changed after Tito's breakup with Stalin.

Title: 793. Malé letní blues
description: Fifteen-year-old Jirina is spending her summer holiday with her father at the family cottage. The father has to go to Prague on business and, after few moments of hesitation, he decides to leave Jirina alone in the cottage. The holiday by the river is pleasant and the gang of children to which Jirina belongs enjoys it duly. Jirina is wooed by Roman, but she is more interested in Franta from the opposite bank of the river. Franta invites the girl to his cottage, but when the more experienced youth wants to kiss her, Jirina runs away. She at the same time finds out to her sorrow that Franta is still dating his love from last year's holidays, Bláza.

Title: 794. Mannen som ikke kunne le
description: A man who can not laugh gets help by a psychiatrist.

Title: 795. Assignment Skybolt
description: Dan Holland, an American secret service agent, goes to Greece to find an hydrogen bomb that was stolen from a NATO base in Turkey. There is the risk that foreign agents will activate the bomb to hit the 6th Fleet flagship while it is anchored outside the port of Piraeus, and thus start a 3rd World War. Dan Holland starts his research with not much information: an antique coin found in the location of the theft that belonged to his brother Jack Holland, code-name Achilles - but Achilles is supposed to have been killed by the Communists during the Greek Civil War.

Title: 796. Black Ear of Corn
description: A young man is driven to corruption and crime.

Title: 797. Die grosse Treibjagd
description: After the war in Congo, two mercenaries take a mission to safeguard uranium transportation in a South American jungle, fighting bandits and local miners.

Title: 798. Freddy klarar biffen
description: Lord Gustaf Fredrik Bock Von Gneising is unsatisfied with the fact that his son Freddy is lazy and unemployed and sends him to his aunt Agda so she can straighten him out.

Title: 799. Artists Under the Big Top: Perplexed
description: "Neues Kino movie" about life in the circus dome narrated in Brechtian spirit; deceptively illusionist grip is broken violently by aloofness and sweeping subjective tracking shots.

Title: 800. Thillana Mohanambal
description: Love between a danseuse and a musician brought under attack from various sources. Will their love survive amidst treachery and competition?

Title: 801. Five Days in Sinai
description: Eight Israeli soldiers are sent on a mission to take control of an enemy missile base, but face a deadly counterattack.

Title: 802. Operación carambola
description: Two clumsy and absent-minded spies (Capulina and Chespirito) are hired to save the world from a nuclear attack.

Title: 803. Affair in the Snow
description: In an isolated mountain resort, a woman gets involved in a love triangle between herself, her volatile lover, and her ex-boyfriend, who she had platonic feelings for.

Title: 804. La trêve
description: Arno, a Paris club owner, heads off early on Saturday with his girlfriend Laura for a day's fishing in the country, on the way to an out-of town, high-roller gambling game to which he has been invited on the Sunday. They run into an old rival, Julien and his girlfriend Fifine, who have similar plans. The fishing is quite unconventional but effective, as one uses electric charges and the other hand grenades. They are being trailed by a gangster Willy and two accomplices. There are various attempts by all parties to sabotage each others efforts. But Arno, Julien and girlfriends manage to enjoy some duck shooting, a leisurely meal of caneton aux cerises and a visit to a ghastly village dance. On reaching the location of the card game they discover Willy has got there first and robbed all the guests of their stakes. Arno and Julien surprise Willy and take back the money, returning it to the guests so that the game is not sabotaged, and settle down to win it legitimately. Willy meanwhile is dumped in a nearby stream.

Title: 806. Vengeance Is My Forgiveness
description: When Sheriff Durango's fiancée and her family are robbed and killed by four masked men, Durango sets out to identify and punish the killers.

Title: 807. Modern Female Ninja: Flesh Hell
description: A member of a group of female ninjas in modern-day Tokyo is kidnapped and sold into slavery. Her sister ninjas seek to rescue her.

Title: 808. The Longest Hunt
description: Mexican land-owner Gutierrez offers to save outlaw Chad Stark in exchange for finding his son Fidel. Stark discovers Fidel isn't Gutierrez' son and chaos ensues.

Title: 809. Aska Tövbe
description: Sehbal is a teacher living in Izmir. Her cousin Mubin calls her to Istanbul. Sehbal hopes that Mubin will propose to her but Mubin says he loves Nazan and wants her to be his matchmaker. But Nazan loves someone else. Mubin disappears after her wedding.

Title: 811. Sleepy Eyes of Death: Hell Is a Woman
description: Two devious retainers are competing to take control of a fief when the current Lord dies, but involving Kyoshiro in the conflict against his will is a bad idea.

Title: 812. Crónica de un atraco
description: Fulgencio and Scott flee the place where they have just committed a robbery. As Fulgencio escapes, the police capture Scott. After serving years in prison, Scott looks for his former partner, who fled to Mexico with the money.

Title: 813. Jane Eyre
description: After a harsh childhood, orphan Jane Eyre is hired by Edward Rochester, the brooding lord of a mysterious manor house, to care for his young daughter.

Title: 814. Zigzag of Luck
description: Winning the lottery turns into a problem when it became clear where the money for ticket was taken from.

Title: 815. Outlaw: Heartless
description: Goro Fujikawa (Tetsuya Watari) was indebted to Mitsugimoto. Sawada, a low rank yakuza with a gambling problem, owed Mitsugimoto three million yen. This equation can only lead to one answer. Mitsugimoto needs to pay and Goro's coming to collect.

Title: 816. Code Name, Red Roses
description: During WWII, an American Major seeks to recover a valuable memorandum from the hands of the Nazis with the help of some partisans.

Title: 817. Trip to Where?
description: Three sailors are talked into trying LSD and marijuana--which, this film implies, are basically the same thing--and the effects of the drugs endanger the lives of their fellow sailors aboard ship.

Title: 818. Bare et liv - historien om Fridtjof Nansen
description: Follow the great adventurer and humanist Fridtjof Nansen to the North Pole, but also his diplomatic skills during the famine in Ukraine, when Norway breaks out of the union with Sweden and his role in establishing the League of Nations.

Title: 819. Cemile
description: The story of two stepbrothers who fall in love with the same woman.

Title: 820. Gorgones kai mages
description: Flora and Petros are competitors who try to buy cheap land on a Greek island and sell it to foreigner investors. During their stay comic things take place ending to find true love in the local residents.

Title: 821. Outlaw: Black Dagger
description: A street war breaks loose between two rival gangs in the Kansai region of Japan. Goro (Tetsuya Watari) is in the middle of action.

Title: 822. Saathi
description: A doctor doing research on cancer treatment faces challenges when he first loses his wife, and then his vision.

Title: 823. Sin with a Stranger
description: François, a journalist, is approached on the train home by a pretty blonde. She leaves at the same station as him and follows him until he ends up inviting her to his house.

Title: 824. Inspektor Blomfields Fall Nr.1 - Ich spreng euch alle in die Luft
description: A thief is killed while trying to escape Inspector Blomfeld. His drug-addicted brother Johnny enters the police station and threatens to blow himself and everyone else up with a bottle of nitroglycerine.

Title: 825. Zita
description: While taking care of her dying aunt Zita, Annie decides to make an evening of it and experience the nightlife of Paris.

Title: 827. Be Seeing You
description: 1967, one year before may '68. The strike at the Rhodiaceta textile plant in Besançon sounds like the rehearsal of the rising to come. Indeed for the first time ever, the workers' claims are not only higher wages or better working conditions but also BETTER LIVING CONDITIONS. They first and foremost say no to the lifestyle capitalism wants to impose on them. One more year to go and the whole country of France will imitate the strikers of Besançon.

Title: 828. Kandil om Hashem
description: Ismail, a medical student, goes to East Germany. He meets a girl there. Back in Egypt, his family struggles financially. After returning as an oculist, he finds patients using oil from an old mosque lamp that worsens their condition.

Title: 829. Sleepy Eyes of Death: In the Spider's Lair
description: Our anti-hero discovers locals who are oppressed, held captive against their will. For the swordsman to succeed, he first must wade through traps and assassins, and a few seductive maidens.

Title: 830. Ciccio Forgives, I Don't
description: Franco and Ciccio are small time horse thieves who get involved with the bandit, El Diablo, and two former members of his gang who are after his gold. Fortunately two pretty, sharp shooting saloon girls come to the bumbling duo's rescue.

Title: 831. The Drifting Avenger
description: Ken, son of a former samurai settles with his family in the west from Japan. Soon his family is killed in front of him by stagecoach robbers, making him aim to get revenge. Marvin an experienced gunman befriends Ken and becomes his mentor.

Title: 832. Adelaide
description: A recently widowed woman in her early 40s receives a visit from a younger engineer. After the funeral of her husband, the two fall in love and marry. But the woman's teenage daughter has eyes for her new stepfather.

Title: 833. A Lady in Sirtaki Dance
description: Surrounded by three overprotective brothers, a little sister can only dream of getting in a relationship with the boys' best friend, and as a result, their reluctance will soon drive him into the arms of another woman. But, can love wait?

Title: 834. Le démoniaque
description: Jay Delanay, the son of a wealthy American film producer showing a film at the Cannes Film Festival, suffers from psychotic disturbances. From his hotel room he spots through his binoculars a beautiful young starlet in a blue bikini. On the pretext of introducing her to his father, he lures her to his room and strangles her. When Sophie, his stepmother, discovers the crime, Jay forces her to keep mum. Other victims will follow...

Title: 835. Wild 90
description: Norman Mailer's first feature filmmaking effort stars the director and his two longtime collaborators Buzz Farbar and Mickey Knox as a trio of gangsters holed up in a ramshackle New York apartment, drinking, braying, and fighting.

Title: 836. Anjaam
description: Shekhar (Feroz Khan) helps C.B.I agent Rekha (Shahida) uncover a plot to smuggle military secrets out of the country.

Title: 837. Le révélateur
description: A 4-year-old child is the element from and around which the action develops, and brings sentiments and emotions to light. The French word révélateur" describes the procedure to develop or "reveal" film negatives.

Title: 838. Snake Woman's Curse
description: An old man dies of heartbreak when a cruel landlord is about to repossess his land. Since the man died in debt, his wife and daughter are indentured servants and are forced to work in the landlord's factory.

Title: 839. Les Contrebandières
description: Two women run packages and people between warring countries, in this New Wave slapstick takeoff on the action and adventure genre.

Title: 840. The World of Hans Christian Andersen
description: During his boyhood, young Hans Christian Andersen is exposed to the musical fairy-tale dream world by Uncle Oley.

Title: 841. Pour un amour lointain
description: Three French actors in Rio De Janeiro find romance and make decisions about their futures.

Title: 842. Una moglie giapponese?
description: An Italian accountant has to replace a sick colleague in a business in the Far East.

Title: 843. A Hard Little Nut
description: During World War II, two Soviet soldiers, man and woman, accidentally fall down on the Nazi camp.

Title: 844. El dependiente
description: Fernandez is a lonely man leading a lonely life. All he does is work for an old man in a hardware store. But all that changes, when he meets the girl of his dreams...and her family.

Title: 845. Cry Wolf
description: A town mayor's son, an imaginative young boy, isn't believed when he discovers a plot to kidnap a visiting Prime Minister.

Title: 846. La concentration
description: An androgynous young man and woman, dressed only in their underwear, locked in a room with a bed.

Title: 848. A Man, Eight Girls
description: Three adventurous city girls take a sail boat to be alone on a deserted island, and find themselves alone with a man - all four captives of five angry lesbians.

Title: 849. Kader
description: A dramatic love story of children of two family who have blood vengeance between them.

Title: 850. Il diario segreto di una minorenne (è nata una donna)
852. Fome de Amor
description: Alfredo, a former revolutionary who is blind, deaf and mute, and his hedonistic wife are visited in their seaside house by another couple, just arriving from New York: a frustrated pianist and her husband, an ex-waiter of dubious character. Relationships of hate, love and sex soon develop between them. They swap wives as a liberation gesture. Besides, the pianist gets a little paranoid, thinking his husband and her friend are trying to eliminate Alfredo and herself, to keep her money.

Title: 853. Three Guns for Texas
description: Several episodes of the TV series "Laredo" edited together and released as a feature.

Title: 855. Avarehaye Tehran
description: A group of people are searching for a treasure plan. Three youngsters manage to find it but it is only the beginning of their troubles.

Title: 857. Lek
description: Norwegian cult movie made up of a series of episodes about how a twenty-year-old man needs to let himself loose.

Title: 858. 24 Hours in the Life of a Woman
description: By the Lake of Lugano, in 1917, Lady Alice Copland, the widow of an English lord, meets Thomas in a casino. The handsome young man has just gambled all his money away. Moved both by his lot and by his good looks, Alice prevents him from committing suicide; comforts him and becomes his mistress. After learning that her lover has deserted the Austrian Army, she gives him the money he needs to return to Zurich and accompanies him to the station. Shortly afterwards she surprises him at the casino, gambling the money she gave him.

Title: 859. Zorro the Fox
description: Zorro, the masked outlaw, fights against the plans of the powerful Don Pedro.

Title: 860. Adam 2
description: Jan Lenica's semi-autobiographical movie about a life of a man under the number "44". He experiences bureaucracy, abusive step-parents, oppression from the government and society. In the end, he tries to get away to the "lost paradise".

Title: 861. The Black Suit Thief
description: Two brothers lost each other in their childhood. When grow up one becomes a thief known as the black suit thief and the other a cop. While they meet each other they have to overcome many troubles against love and law.

Title: 862. Kahin Aur Chal
description: Shail is devastated when he finds his wife Leela having an affair with his friend Paul. He shoots Paul and then runs away. After surviving a suicide attempt Shail found out that Paul and Leela are spending Shail's money.

Title: 863. Brat doktora Homera
description: This film predominantly deals with the problems of a young man whom his delusions led into conflict with society. These issues will throw him into an adventure that would be tragic for him, but still helpful for him to see the truth. The story takes place in Kosovo in 1945, in an atmosphere of uncured wounds, wandering, betrayal, burned homes, typhoid and other postwar misery. An authentic story from those days was taken as the film's basis.

Title: 864. Kitten in a Cage
description: We meet Julie as she escapes from a mental institution. She seeks refuge with her boss and friend, a nightclub owner. They all have to fight for their lives when a group of jewel thieves come after them.

Title: 865. Ezo Gelin
description: Tragedy strikes when Ezo's husband, who is thought to be dead, arrives. Because now Ezo has married her husband's brother.

Title: 866. Oscuros sueños de agosto
description: After spending several years in Venezuela, Isabel returns to Spain to heal from a neurosis. Her daughter Ana, abandoned by the woman when she was a four-year-old girl, decides to accompany her to the hospital. There, Ana meets Mario, a handsome and tormented alcoholic.

Title: 867. Better a Widow
description: In this delightful romantic comedy, Peter McEnery plays Tom Proby, a representative from a British engineering firm. He is sent to Sicily to convince the landowners (all in the Mafia) to allow his company to build an oil refinery on some waterfront real estate. Proby talks to the mob bosses about the project, but disagreements between different bosses complicate his efforts. One group wants to build the refinery, the other prefers a luxurious resort. Proby meets Rosa (Virna Lisi), the beautiful daughter of a mafia don, and the two begin a flirtation. Since Rosa is engaged to another mob boss, she creates a stir when she declares her love for Proby. The mob fights over the issue of the refinery and Proby courts danger by romancing Rosa.

Title: 869. As Amorosas
description: A young man in his early 30's ponders the state of his life while dealing with three women - his sister, his new girlfriend and his lover.

Title: 870. The Nephews of Zorro
description: Two fellows from Sicily go to America thinking that they will find gold . For their bad luck in California they meet the brave Zorro who is protecting the helpless people. They have to help him which is followed by a lot of adventures and funny moments.

Title: 871. Anémone
description: The portrait of a young girl from the Parisian bourgeoisie.

Title: 872. Phedre
description: In the absence of her royal husband Theseus, thought to be dead, Phaedra declares her love to Hippolyte, Theseus's son from a previous marriage.

Title: 874. Volver a vivir
description: A former soccer player is morally and mentally destroied by the death of his wife. But when he gets the chance to train a team he regains his life by making victories and also finding another love.

Title: 875. I Need a Ride to California
description: Follows a group of hippies in Greenwich Village during the 60's revolution, centering on the story of a girl in the East Village neighborhood, exploring her various relationships with men, and her search for values of the time.

Title: 876. Agente 00 Sexy
description: The beautiful Agent 00 is sent by the girlfriend of a mafia boss to catch his band of miscreants.

Title: 877. The Sun Above, Death Below
description: Suspense drama about an assassin charged with breaking up a gold smuggling ring, and the contract subsequently purchased against him and his employer.

Title: 879. Death and Diamonds
description: (1968) George Nader. Heinz Weiss, Sylvia Solar, Carl Mohner. Agent Jerry Cotton infiltrates a big crime syndicate that is planning a major diamond heist. Jerry is able to make off with the loot himself - 12 million bucks! Watch for a cool chase scene at the film's climax. Color, 35mm.

Title: 880. Lucio Vázquez
description: After avenging the death of Emiliano Zapata, a revolutionary reunites with his childhood sweetheart, the daughter of the man who had the revolutionary's father killed.

Title: 881. La vil seducción
description: Alicia is a movie actress who, eventually, is part of a theater company that goes through the towns representing Zorrilla's "Don Juan Tenorio". She is tired of the public only appreciating her beauty, but she is not satisfied with her work in the play either. After a stormy rehearsal, she flees the theater dressed in the habit of Doña Inés, but her car sinks in a pothole at the entrance of a town, for which she has to go to a mechanic.

Title: 882. Tricks of the Trade
description: A married man gets blackmailed by a degenerate couple after having a one-night threesome with them.

Title: 883. Nihiki no yojimbo
description: Two vagabonds with sharp weapons fall in love with the same woman, based on a popular story by Shin Hasegawa.

Title: 884. The Day Has Gone
description: On receiving a letter from her mother, a quiet working-class girl leaves the state orphanage in Budapest where she grew up and takes a trip to the rural countryside to visit her.

Title: 885. Don Chisciotte and Sancio Panza
description: Comic version of the famous man of la Mancha by Miguel de Cervantes in which Don Quixote having read an adventure book too many sets out on his own adventures with his servant Sancho Panza.

Title: 886. La pecora nera
description: Mario and Filippo are two twin brothers, the honorable one want to bring morality back into Italian political life, as president of the Commission for the investigation of corruption. The other brother is a cynical trickster.

Title: 887. The Diary of Knockers McCalla
description: Beverly "Knockers" McCalla finds that being endowed with powerful sexual drives as well as a very large bust are two big advantages on the road to riches. Having had an affair with her stepfather, she leaves home. When a young man picks her up, she has sex with him in the back seat of the car. He drives her to a roadhouse which operates as an undercover brothel; she is an enormous success. After a run-in with one of the patrons, she moves on to Kansas City and works for one of the largest call girl syndicates in the state. When the police close in, she is sent to New York to become part of the party girl racket. A gangland killing interrupts her climb to riches. Fleeing from the scene of the crime, "Knockers" is picked up by Peter Stackpoole, a wealthy man who proves his honest intentions by marrying her. He dies on their wedding night, leaving "Knockers" $10 million.

Title: 888. Stress Is Three
description: An industrialist drives to the sea with his wife and best friend, who he thinks are starting an affair. As the two flirt, he becomes increasingly paranoid. Will he end his agony by killing the would-be lover, the inconstant wife or himself?

Title: 889. Kad lietus un veji sitas loga
description: The Second World War is over. In Latvia, an attempt to combine the forces of the "forest brothers" with a serious resistance movement is struggling to fail.

Title: 890. Kirmizi fener sokagi
description: The adaptation of Irma la Douce.

Title: 891. Hitler IIIº Mundo
description: The ascension of a Nazi leader in the third world.

Title: 892. Blind Date
description: The illegal relationship of the wife of the prosecutor of a provincial town turns into a nightmare.

Title: 893. Ragan
description: A former mercenary named Ragan, who now runs a one-plane, money-losing air-transport service, is approached by a man named Velludo with a $75,000 job offer. Velludo wants Ragan to fly a plane in a mission to free Moreno, the former dictator of a Caribbean island. Ragan says "no" but his plane is mysteriously destroyed in a fire and his insurance is suddenly cancelled so "no" becomes "yes." After all, Moreno is preferable to Chavez, the current dictator, and Ragan will have to chance to meet up with an ex-flame named Janine who's also involved in the planned coup along with her husband. Complicating things, however, is Maria, an attractive blonde with the "hots" for Ragan. Ragan and company incur heavy losses but manage to free Moreno in a daring commando raid and Ragan now looks forward to a romantic future with one of those two women.

Title: 895. I giovani tigri
description: Five seventeen-year-olds from Milan decide to spend their holidays in the city and end up in a big villa, where a party is held.

Title: 896. Forbidden Flesh
description: The hottest girl in the hills and her best friend have just met a traveling salesman. Trying to hold off on these vicious virgins, he begins telling different bizarre sexual stories of the big cities he's been to, which of course gets the two nymphs all worked up. He finally succumbs to their advances only to be interrupted by a mama welding a shotgun.

Title: 897. La ley del gavilán
description: The Law of the Hawk (1968). A masked man known as "The Hawk" steals from the rich to help the poor, and he also attempts to solve a case of kidnapping.

Title: 899. Parenthesi
description: Two strangers experience romance during a six hour train delay.

Title: 900. Baazi
description: Elizabeth's uncle is in deep financial crisis. He somehow manages to prove his own death and cremate someone else's body in order to claim Rs.250,000 (a huge amount during 60s) from the insurance company. Inspector Ajay unfolds the mystery.

Title: 901. Ne jouez pas avec les Martiens
description: Two journalists covering the birth of quintuplets in Brittany find themselves faced with a national security affair: the hospital nurse used their telex for fun and sent news to Paris announcing the landing of Martians.

Title: 902. Michael and Helga
description: Shows the growth to adulthood of children of both sexes, emphasizing emotional development in relation to the sexual instinct. Explicit cartoons present certain genetic and biological aspects.

Title: 903. Eskiya Halil
description: Duran Aga kills Eskiya Halil's father and withholds Halil's fiancee and tries to take villagers's field forcible. Because of these Eskiya Halil escapes from prison to revenge.

Title: 904. Viagem ao Fim do Mundo
description: During a flight, passengers confront their aspirations, frustrations, fears, wishes and fears, mixing up reality and fiction.

Title: 906. Zum Teufel mit der Penne - Die Lümmel von der ersten Bank, 2. Teil
description: Dr. Peter Roland, a Geneva TV reporter and prankster, is ordered as punishment to cover the German schools. So he cheats his brother in law William 'Willy' Tell to steal his identity as exchange program teacher in Mommsen gymnasium (classical high school) in Baden-Baden (SW Germany). There he's assigned to class 10a, where local businessman Kurt Notnagel's son Pepe rules the pranking roost. Instead of siding with principal Dr. Gottlieb Taft's staff, he can't resist teaming up with Pepe, whose sister Marion digs slick Peter.

Title: 907. Vengeance of the Phoenix Sisters
description: After bandits kill a former sheriff and his wife, a servant carries their three daughters to safety, but they grow up apart. Fifteen years later, each girl sets out to seek revenge. Eldest sister Xiufeng disguises herself as a man, performing acts of chivalry as she seeks out the bandits. Along the way, she runs across her sisters, Qingfeng and Zhifeng.

Title: 908. El marino de los puños de oro
description: Pedro Montero is a renowned Spanish boxer who returns to Spain. On the eve of the European Championship, his rival's agents send him a dangerous woman, an old friend he had in Rome, to hinder his physical preparation.

Title: 909. Balram Shri Krishna
description: After liberating the people of Mathura from the tyrannical rule of Kans, Krishna turns his attention to wedding Princess Rukmini, at Narad Muni's behest. Meanwhile, the disgruntled kings of neighboring kingdoms launch repeated attacks on Mathura to avenge the death of Kans and preemptively protect their states. To avoid sacrificing innocent lives in the chronic war against their enemies, Krishna and Balram flee and relocate their capital to Dwarka. However, between battling armies, the brothers are still not at peace as they are busy quarreling amongst themselves over whom their sister Subhadra should marry. Balram, wishing to see his sister as Queen of Hastinapur, wants her to marry prince Duryodhan, while Krishna is partial to his cousin Arjun and enacts a plan to see his desires fulfilled. Can Krishna and Balram settle their differences, or will their persistent feuding spell the end of the illustrious Yadav line?

Title: 910. The Model Killer
description: Strange dreams and desires torture the mind of Erik Lorac (Paul Norman), a respectable Hollywood corporate attorney. Joanne, his wife (Sandra Hunt), is concerned with his fitful sleep and distraught condition. With good reason. What Joanne doesn't know, nor the police, and scarcely Erik, is that he leads a double life-a busy lawyer, yes, but also a sex psychopath who stalks the streets in search of new victims-always young, beautiful girls. Posing as a magazine photographer, he promises the pretty models he encounters big money for posing for his camera. Luring them to a modest Hollywood apartment filled with erotic curios, or taking them "on location" into the lonely woods, he rapes and strangles them. Erik "makes the scene" at beauty pageants, Hippie love-ins, wife-swapping orgies, but is somehow always strangely adrift, ignored by others. The authorities have dubbed the unknown slayer, "The Model Killer". Detectives have virtually no clues, until the father of one of the slain girls, Walter Winstead (Doodles Weaver), a Midwest plumbing contractor, arrives in town. To the dismay of the police, he begins a strange manhunt all his own.

Title: 911. Golden Eyes
description: An assassin goes on the trail of an international gold smuggling ring based in Japan.

Title: 912. History of Japanese Sexual Behavior: Forced Double Suicide
description: In a traditional Japanese fishing village, two teen-aged lovers are forced to commit suicide after their illicit relations have been discovered by the village elder.

Title: 913. Galatta Kalyanam
description: A man is burdened with the unenviable task of finding suitable grooms for his lady love's sisters.

Title: 914. A Little of What You Fancy
description: Documentary following the history of British Music Hall, its stars and architecture, interspersed with revivals of old favourites by todays performers.

Title: 915. The Tiger of Mazandaran
description: Based on Pouryaye Vali's story Habib is a young local woodcutter and wrestler who lives in the north of Iran. But Bashir Khan and his gang have problems with him and are after him. Habib becomes local champion and for a wrestling match goes to Mashhad. There when he goes to pilgrim he finds the mother of his opponent Keivan praying for her son. Habib loses his match but no one knows why. He returns to his village to find that Bashir Khan and his gang have plotted him but Keivan and his mother come to defend him.

Title: 916. Les Gauloises bleues
description: The movie explores the love, or lack thereof, of a spouse and a parent, absurdities and tragedies of life, growing-up and death, and humanity under various social and political influences. Ivan's life, and his unhappy relationship with his wife and father, are told through interweaving flashbacks as his wife is attempting to give birth. The title refers to the cigarettes he was buying from her when he met her while down on his luck. They fall in love but constantly fight, while he resorts to crime. The movie's many artsy vignettes vary widely between provocative interviews and dialogue, symbolic scenes of Ivan as a child stomping a gift of bread into the ground, surreal images of death, absurdities of silly bureaucracies and indifference in hospitals, scenes of political upheaval mixed with innocent images of a children's book, and so on. This is a hodgepodge of subtly impressionistic scenes that come together to weave a character study and portrait of life. At times it was a wonderfully surreal and intriguing artistic creation.

Title: 917. Les aventures de Lagardère
description: A young man, Lagardère, discovers that a plot is afoot to assassinate the Duke of Nevers. He warns him and flees with his daughter, Aurore.

Title: 919. Hellish Spiders
description: Arácnea's residents have been desperately searching for a source of food to save the life of their queen. Earth is chosen, since human brains are apparently like health food for alien spiders.

Title: 920. The Sex Check
description: A former Olympic hopeful whose career was derailed by war becomes a gigolo. When he discovers a gifted young runner, he sees redemption in coaching her to glory - until bureaucratic gender testing threatens their dreams.

Title: 921. Humsaya
description: A disgraced Indian air force officer impersonates a look-alike Chinese spy.

Title: 922. El as de oros
description: A cowboy falls for a city socialite, then struggles to recover after she dumps him.

Title: 923. Maratón
description: It is 5 May 1945 and the uprising against the hated German occupiers has broken out in Prague. The Czech guards open the gate of the Pankrác prison to allow the prisoners to escape en masse. Many of them are shot dead by the German guards but young Ruda (Jaromír Hanzlík) manages to run away. He is taken care of by one of the Prague fighters, concierge Kytka. Kytka hides him in the flat of the house's owner where only the young maid Karla (Jana Brejchová) is left, ordering her to take care of Ruda.

Title: 924. I ragazzi di Bandiera Gialla
description: A group of beatnik students rent a garage and turn it into a club. One of them leaves because of love rivalry but then goes back on his steps and the club becomes a huge success.

Title: 925. God's Police Patrol
description: The accomplices of a gentleman gangster who was killed in an airplane accident tries to persuade the accident minister to break the confessional secret in order to obtain a large amount of money that had been stolen.

Title: 926. Julia, Anna, Genowefa
description: 25-year-old Anna works in the laboratory of the Lodz textile factory. She lives with her mother and recently married husband. Her life collapses when a stranger appears, looking for a daughter who has disappeared during the war.

Title: 927. Monsieur Hawarden
description: Meriora Gillibrand (Ellen Vogel) disguises herself as a man to avoid prosecution for murdering her lover.

Title: 928. Outlaw: Gangster VIP 2
description: YAKUZA GANGSTER THRILLER

Title: 929. Go for Broke
description: The Indian called Copper Face is suspected to have stolen a large quantity of gold from a bank.

Title: 930. Sarajevski atentat
description: A resistance fighter in WWII Sarajevo is running from the Gestapo and finds shelter in the home of an old man who is a former member of the Mlada Bosna organization and tells the young man about his youth and events that which led to the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo.

Title: 932. Kuang lian shi
description: Two brothers lust after the same girl in the summer scene of 60's.

Title: 933. Peter und Sabine
description: Three brothers and their sexual problems. Jens, 20 y.o., becomes divorcée Claudia's lover. Jan, 13 y.o., loves Lilo who loves Jacques. Peter, 16 y.o., dates Sabine against her mother's will, who sends Sabine to another school. Peter then becomes involved with another girl, who seduces and abandons him. He then has an affair with waitress Gitte, who tries to squeeze money out of Peter, pretending she's expecting their baby. Jacques manages the situation, so that Peter, now wiser about the facts of life, can fight for Sabine again.

Title: 934. Private Relations
description: Earl Dudley is a young New York City PR (public relations) man with a posh office in the Brill Building who, despite having wealthy socialite Willi Trueblood as his girlfriend, is drowning in debt and desperately trying to hide from creditors. It's a situation that only gets worse when he inherits a house on Long Island from a deceased uncle who owed a fortune in back taxes. But when Earl gets wind of a Texas hillbilly singer named "Corny" Wilson, he decides Corny's exactly the kind of client he needs to revive his business, and sets about trying to woo Corny's manager, Romney Elrod. But the manager proves to be a tough nut to crack. In a last-ditch attempt to land the contract, Earl decides to hatch a little blackmail attempt by having actress Katie Mallory seduce Corny during a weekend retreat at the Long Island house, with the action to be captured on a hidden camera, but this fails as well as Elrod claims to have been a porn distributor since '58.

Title: 936. The Night of the Three Lovers
description: One Saturday night, Jenny and Vera are sequestered at home by an armed man who wants a big sum of money. As the two girls have no cash, he agrees to wait until they can withdraw the money on Monday morning; then he binds them on the bed and, tired out himself, falls asleep. The next morning, he--Max Sorini by name, a former legionary--tells his story to his two victims: having surprised his wife Nathalie in the company of her lover, he fell upon his rival and in the ensuring fight the lover killed Nathalie and fled. The police, believing that Max had done the manslaughter, arrested him, but he had managed to escape while being transferred to prison. Now he needs money for his defense.

Title: 937. The Cat Has Nine Lives
description: Three women, a journalist, her French friend and a pop singer, deal with life, career, desire, sex and personal fantasies.

Title: 938. Haci Murat geliyor
description: a sequel to another film of "Haci Murad" Seyh Samil and Haci Murat continue to fight with Russian giaours.

description: Rena, a devoted wife, grapples with the nagging suspicion that Argiris, her husband, may be involved with someone else. And then, she finds a seductive white baby doll in his briefcase. Has her worst fear come true?

Title: 940. Capitu
description: Adaptation of Machado de Assis's classic novel "Dom Casmurro". Bentinho and Capitu are friends since childhood and end up marrying. But Bentinho destroys his life when he starts suspecting Capitu has an affair with his best friend and that his son is not really his.

Title: 943. Dil Aur Mohabbat
description: Widowed by his wife's sudden passing, Superintendent of Police Choudhry brings up his son Rajesh on his own, teaches him all known good values, and when he grows up sends him to College in Bombay, and remits money to him regularly. Choudhry would like to transfer to Bombay Police, so that he can be close to his son, then one day out of the blue, his transfer is approved, and a delighted Choudhry writes to his son to fetch him from the railway station. Upon arrival in Bombay, he does not find his son at the Railway Station, but when browsing through a newspaper he sees his son's photograph--wanted for the murder of a card-sharp. Shocked and dismayed, Choudhry attempts to piece his life together and attempts to find Rajesh before the City Police do--for he may well face the death sentence. Choudhry does find him, but only after Rajesh is accused of killing a woman named Kishori, and this time Choudhry is quite sure that there is no hope for Rajesh.

Title: 944. The New Adventures of the Elusive Avengers
description: Young heroes hunt for a secret map behind enemy lines. The second part of the film cycle, filmed at the request of the audience

Title: 945. Los canallas
description: The leader and villain of the movie is called Kadena, a buxom girl, who is the real deal of the gang "Hell's Angels" and whose goal is to kill the Mil Mascaras as sending to jail to his sweetheart consented. What force our hero to fight to bad and bad.

Title: 946. Khronika pikiruyushchego bombardirovshchika
description: Film about the week-days of front aviation in the years of Great Patriotic war.

Title: 948. Come stranger
description: A young guy leaves his pregnant girlfriend and goes to Europe to study. The disappointed girl try to commit suicide but at last moments is saved by the brother of that guy. He marries her and she give birth to a boy. After few years the man is back from Europe and feel lonely so wants her back.

Title: 949. Der nächste Herr, dieselbe Dame
description: Madame Feh wants to build an erotic spa home when she is released from prison. She does it, too. But in the end, she ends up behind bars again.

Title: 952. Nalum Therindavan
description: Watch the full movie, Naalum Therinthavan, only on Eros Now. Naalum Therinthavan is a 1968 Indian Tamil film, directed by C. P. Jambulingam and produced by Sri Balaji Combines. The film stars Ravichandran, Kanchana, Anjali Devi, Nagesh in lead roles. The film had musical score by MS Vishvanathan.

Title: 953. The Girl Grabbers
description: Nick and Louie are two degenerates who assault a young woman in her Greenwich Village apartment. The woman's boyfriend, Paul, embarks on a quest to find and get revenge against the two thugs which leads him to the seedy underbelly of New York's red light district from a strip club to a local brothel where Paul meets and has sexual encounters with a few women to learn the identity of the two 'girl grabbers' leading to a drug deal between the two thugs and a powerful gangster.

Title: 954. No More Excuses
description: Downey takes his camera and microphone onto the streets (and into some bedrooms) for a look at Manhattan's singles scene of the late sixties. Of course, that's not all: No More Excuses cuts between this footage and the fragmented tale of a time-traveling Civil War soldier, a rant from the director of the fictional Society for Indecency to Naked Animals, and other assorted improprieties.

Title: 955. The Taste of Vengeance
description: A group of Northern vigilantes, roaming the post Civil War south, attack and kill the fiancee of war veteran Brian who is rescued by his friend, Daniel. The two, with brother Robert, set out to find the killers but Brian suffers from amnesia.

Title: 956. Three Crosses Not to Die
description: Jerry, Reno and Paco are in prison, where they meet a young Mexican man who claims he has been convicted for a crime he hasn't committed. Mysteriously, the three men are released of prison and proceed to prove the Mexican man's innocence.

Title: 957. Qian mian da dao
description: The Gun Brother is a mysterious and unidentified rebel who attacks the Japanese forces. By day he's a suave playboy and by night he is raiding the enemy.

Title: 961. Two Brothers, One Death
description: Bill Anderson and his band of ex Confederates are terrorizing the town of Springfield and its environs, sucking it dry of any wealth. Local dignitaries call in the Pinkerton agency to help.

Title: 962. Manila, Open City
description: As Allied Forces are closing the curtains on the Japanese Army in Manila, Japanese soldiers begin to attack innocent civilians.

Title: 963. Memories of the Future
description: During the cristero revolution federalist Rosas arrives in a town together with his lover and a local woman feels strangely attracted to him. Based on Elena Garro novel.

Title: 964. Scusi, lei conosce il sesso?
description: Using interviews and filmed reconstructions, the director analyzes eroticism from the period of breastfeeding, in which the newborn feels pleasure from contact with the mother's breast until reaching adulthood.

Title: 965. Descendants of Cain
description: Film depicting North Koreans extorting the land and property of civilians in the name of revolution after the liberation from Japan in 1945.

Title: 966. Athina, i klopi tis odou Stadiou
description: An art student and her diabolical lover pull off a perfect smash-and-grab jewel heist in broad daylight. To finish the job, the ruthless duo attempts to extort money from a wealthy target, unaware that greed and betrayal go hand in hand.

Title: 967. Otoko no okite
description: A decently-executed but fairly routine, contemporary ninkyô programmer.

Title: 968. Un día después de agosto
description: The story of a couple struggling because of some love obstacles.

Title: 969. My Third Wife, George
description: Ralph Higbee is a 40-year-old drunkard who lives with his mother to take care of her. When his mother dies, he picks up three women who persuade him to take LSD for an experience. Seeking a companionship to replace his mother, Ralph meets and soon marries Josephine, but he is unable to satisfy her constant desire for sex. He leaves her when he finds out that she has other male and female lovers. Ralph marries a second time, but his second wife is also unfaithful and successfully scams him out of most of his money by hiring a private detective to force him to bed down a female stenographer. Marring for the third time, Ralph is finally happy... until he cheats on her for no good reason and when she finds out... there will literal hell to pay.

Title: 970. Po xiao shi fen
description: A young guard witnesses the corruption of the system during his first night call in the tribunal. A series of dramatic stories told by each prisoner to the judge ensues in flashbacks. The young guard has some doubt of conscience on his new job, but an elder guard who is also his uncle reassures him it's just a matter of time. The guard back home at dawn forgetting every injustice he witnessed because his wife has just given birth to a baby.

Title: 973. Asfalttilampaat
description: The story of a doomed young love in a small, narrow-minded town.

Title: 974. Trilogy of Terror
description: "Trilogia de Terror" (Trilogy of Terror) is a 1968 Brazilian horror film by Brazilian film director/actor José Mojica Marins.

Title: 975. Adriatic Sea of Fire
description: In April 1941,Germany invaded Yugoslavia without a declaration of war;aboard a destroyer ,opinions differ:shall we surrender or shall we join the British fleet in Malta?Two young lieutenants would like to continue the war,but their superior is a coward and it's a capitulation . Both officers refuse to salute the new flag .Lieutenant Michel Masic and his companion carry on with their fight :after their sacrifice ,all their men will become resistant fighters .

Title: 976. Fever Heat
description: In his final film role, Nick Adams is a young mechanic who finds danger and romance in the exciting, sometimes unscrupulous world of stock-car racing.

Title: 977. One Day, My Daddy...
description: The attempt of the daughter of an Eastern Bloc country leader to escape to a country in the West.

Title: 979. The Husband Hunt
description: When his girlfriend's father opposes their marriage, a taxi driver acts as a temporary husband for an heiress targeted by her greedy ex. The scheme fails, allowing the driver and his beloved to wed.

Title: 980. Io ti amo
description: During an air trip, Prince Tancredi, a well-known abstract artist, gets to know air hostess Judy and is charmed by the young woman. When he asks her to pose for him Judy accepts. Following a few negative remarks on her part about his work Tancredi is driven to question himself artistically. Now, Judy has to leave but she promises to see Tancredi again, which they do. Their mutual attraction soon turns into a burning passion. As Judy will soon benefit from a week off they promise each other to live this blessed period to the full. The young woman leaves, Tancredi returns to his studio and works hard at her portrait, bringing it the magic of his sincere, intense feelings. When the time comes to join Judy, he learns in horror that she got killed in a car accident the very day when she had left him while she had decided to drive back and was happily returning to him.

Title: 982. Villervalle i Söderhavet
description: Villervalles dad is a nutrition specialist at Unesco, he is sent to some Pacific islands to investigate if there is starvation there. The family insists on coming along on the trip.

Title: 983. Schüsse unterm Galgen
description: In Scotland in 1751, young David Balfour is shanghaied aboard a ship where he meets Jacobite rebel Alan Breck Stewart with whom he escapes to the Scottish Highlands, dodging the redcoats.

Title: 984. Escuela de enfermeras
description: Lucia is a wild young woman who leaves her old life behind to study to be a nurse. At school, Lucia meets Cristina and Gloria who will teach her to value true friendship.

Title: 988. Det var en lørdag aften
description: The young girl Trine is expecting her boyfriend, the sailor Hans, home on Saturday night. They look forward to being together, but he never show up and Trine socialize with her neighbors instead.

Title: 989. Two Girls for a Madman
description: Two young girls studying to be ballet dancers in New York City are chosen by a crazed sex fiend to be his next victims. He rapes one of them at gunpoint, then goes on to stalk and terrorize both of them.

Title: 990. Noin 7 veljestä
description: Medieval knight spoof about Sir Wilhelm who wants to court beautiful Helena, the daughter of evil von Wurstburg living in his large castle. People around the village also include Robin Hood, the hero of the local peasants, inventor Leonardo, and a troubadour explaining the plot to the viewer.

Title: 991. A Face of War
description: No other film carries the viewer closer to the reality and savagery of the Vietnam War. Here is what the American soldier saw, heard, and felt on the front lines, recorded shoulder to shoulder with the fighting man.

Title: 992. Storm Over Petra
description: To dismantle a dangerous smuggling ring in Petra, police recruit a penniless young man to infiltrate the group. Posing as an arms dealer, he teams up with secret agents to rescue a captive, defeat the gang, and start a new life.

Title: 993. Orgy Girls '69
description: A five-part story detailing women and sex. In "The Housewife", a door-to-door salesman makes love to a lonely housewife. In "The Roomates" a woman and her date have sex, they awaken the woman's roomate who joins them. In "The Sensualist" two women make love to each other. In "The Fasion Model" a young model discovers more then posing in the nude for her attractive photographer. In "The Hippie" a woman smokes pot and makes love to an older man who wants to take her away from her bohemian life.

Title: 997. Les idoles
description: The rise and fall of a pop/rock trio immersed in the counterculture of the 1960's. The rebel Charly, the audacious Gigi and the thoughtful Simon present their stories, thoughts and feelings in countless songs, dealing with audience demands and also the pressures from their business managers. Fame and show business are a constant tightrope.

Title: 998. El satánico
description: It follows the exploits of a small gang of jewel thieves who employ a little person as their ultimate tool.

Title: 1000. Meddig él az ember? I-II
description: In the factory where he repairs machines, an old man spends his last day at work before his colleagues say goodbye at a retirement party. A young self-conscious teen leaves his village and family to start training as an apprentice in town.
